headline: Solution- and people-oriented IT supporter
summary: In my time as a Data and Applications Support Engineer I have worked with many tools across data and software. Mainly within the Azure tech stack, I know Terraform as infrastructure as code, and to a lesser degree Google Cloud Platform. I have worked with SQL, including serverless SQL, and with integrating SQL queries into Power BI reports. I have also supported internally developed applications: debugging issues reported by users right down to log level and error-code analysis, raising work items for the backlog, and implementing the fixes myself with AI-assisted coding.
personal: I grew up in a home with three developmentally disabled individuals, who taught me everything from patience to gratitude. Those are qualities that make me a good colleague, teammate and friend. My time as a personal care assistant in particular refined my sense of when to be a friend, when to be a colleague, and when to be the fly on the wall.
